name: 81505 · Grand Jct, CO
findings: ZIP 81505 (Grand Jct) has 81 nonprofit organizations. 36 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 27 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 81505 (Grand Jct) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 81505 (Grand Jct) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.8 times the typical level).
